formatNote: Written by test/scripts/routing_engine_fixtures.mjs from journeys.json and starts.json, whose frontiers are written by hand. Each case holds the arguments of createEngine: the stop count, the connection columns in departure order with the boarding and alighting flags as 1 or 0, the walking link columns in the order of the stop they leave, and the minimum transfer. Each query is as route ('leaving') or routeArrivingBy ('arrivingBy') takes it, with its expected frontier, stops and connections as indices into the case's columns.

a walk from the origin and a walk after a ride
no boarding and no alighting where a stop forbids them
a walk keeps the ride it follows when a later walk reaches its starting stop earlier
a stop dwell boards at its departure and alights at its arrival
a ride's walk is taken where a walk from the origin reached its stop sooner
a ride's walk is taken where a walk to the target leaves its stop later
a trip that passes the target before the origin is not ridden back to it
two rides whose walks reach the target at one second keep the first scanned
two walks to rides that leave the origin at one second keep the first scanned
a walk alone stays on the frontier beside a faster ride
a hop departing at the time a query arrives by is ridden
a journey takes at most six rides
a start from a position boards where its walk arrives in time
